items.control_limits_en: 1890–1941: Colony proclaimed 1890 (OHM start_date 1890-01-01). Limits with Ethiopia fixed by Italo-Ethiopian treaties 1900/1902/1908 (the EEBC 2002 mandate was to delimit on these treaties – EEBC2002; treaty texts themselves not read). | 1941–1952: British administration from 1941 (OHM start 1941-11-27) until federation. | 1952–1962: Federation under the Ethiopian Crown per UNGA 390 (V) A of 2 Dec 1950; in force 1952. | 1962–1993: Federation dissolved 1962 (OHM end 1962); armed struggle 1961–91; EPLF took Asmara May 1991 [VERIFY date source]; de facto control not traced. | 1993–2026: Independence 1993 after UN-observed referendum (OHM 2803445 start 1993). Sudan–Eritrea border unchanged from colonial line.

items.control_limits_en: 1900–1910: French conquest from 1900; north (Borkou, Ennedi, Tibesti) not occupied until 1910s [VERIFY]. | 1910–1960: Northern limit by Anglo-French 1899 declaration and 1919 convention (tripoint 19°30'N 24°E); Tibesti transferred from Niger to Chad 18 Mar 1931; Franco-Italian accord of 7 Jan 1935 moving the line south never ratified. Chad–Sudan line per 1924 exchange of notes. | 1960–2026: Independence 1960 (OHM 2801984 start 1960-08-11).
